Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms and Conditions 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses --- TENDER NO: MnC/NR/UPSO-I/LUB/PT-95/26-27/GeM & GEM Bid ID: GEM/2026/B/7963049 Buyer Added Text Based ATC Causes
1.0EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD): NIL Bidders to note that there shall be no requirement of paying EMD against this e-Tender. However, all bid ders shall be required to mandatorily submit the Bid Security Declaration in lieu of EMD as per the standard format attached (Annexure-K of Part-B of tender document) The requirement of submission of Bid Security Declaration Shall also be applicable on bidders who are exempted from payment of EMD (MSEs as per PPP, Startups, CPSEs and JVs). The bid shall be liable for rejection if Bid Security Declaration in lieu of EMD is not uploaded in e-Tendering portal on or before tender submission date and time.
2.0Name of Work and Quantum of Supply: Supply & installation of 700 nos. of SERVO branded Lube Display rack to Retail outlets in various cities under UPSO-I.
3.0ESTIMATED VALUE OF WORK Rs. 2,05,59,140.00 /- (Rupees Two Crore Five Lacs Fifty-Nine Thousand and One Hundred Forty only) including GST @ 18%.
4.0Technical Specification is attached in Technical Commercial bid document Part-A
5.0SECURITY DEPOSIT (SD) CUM PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Security Deposit shall be 5% of the order value at the time of dispatch and the same shall be valid till delivery/completion period plus warranty period plus 6 months.
6.0PQ CRITERIA AND EVALUATION CRITERIA: Please refer to Part-A of technical commercial bid document
6.1Similar Work Criteria: As per ATC Clause 29.1 Work completed by the bidder, as main contractor, or as sub-contractor, during last 05 (Five) years ending
--- on last day of month immediately previous to the month in which last date of bid submission falls (i.e. between 01.09.2021 to 31.08.2026). The value inclusive of GST of completed work for evaluation shall be considered as under: 1. Three similar completed orders, each executed for similar items costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 37.01 Lakhs OR 2. Two similar completed orders, each executed for similar items costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 49.35 Lakhs OR 3. One similar completed order, each executed for similar items costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 61.68 Lakhs The last date of order execution shall fall in the above-mentioned period. ## DEFINITION OF SIMILAR ITEMS: ## Definition of Similar Works/Items: experience in Supply of Lube display Rack for purpose of Product promotion or in shop branding or installation of Boards made of ACP/ Flex/ Sunboard, Signage Work or Hoarding works or Any other Brand promotion related works shall only be considered as similar work during last 5 years ending last day of month previous to the original date of bid submission end date. The Work order should contain the above similar work items and for qualification purposes the entire executed value of Work Order (which may contain any other items) shall be considered. Work executed by a bidder for its own plant/projects shall not be considered as experience for the purpose of meeting requirement of experience criteria of the tender. The experience of bidding entity only will be considered. The experience of the bidder for work completed as per above requirement must be of their own and not with the support of another party/ parent company/ subsidiary/ partner firm/ group firm/backup firm or as part of a consortium etc. The credentials of the parent company, Joint Venture Partner Company, subsidiary company etc. shall not be considered --- 6.2 ANNUAL TURNOVER: As per ATC Clause 29.2 The turnover of the Tenderers during any of the preceding three financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) should be at least Rs 74.02 Lakhs 7.0 OTHER MANDATORY DOCUMENTS: As per ATC Clause 31 8.0 Purchase Preference: PPP- MSE order 2012 and PPP_MII Order, 2017 along with their amendments is concurrently a applicable. 9.0 Reverse Auction: Applicable as per GeM Modality 3. atc_analysis.raw_markdown:
### 1. Standard Documents Required
* **Experience Criteria**
* **Bidder Turnover**

### 2. Clarified ATC Documents & Mandatory Uploads
* **Certificate**: **MSE Udyam Certificate** or **Startup Recognition Certificate** (issued by DPIIT)
* **Additional Doc 1**: **Bid Security Declaration** (Annexure-K)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **PAN Card** (Proprietor or Firm name)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **GST Registration Certificate**
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Partnership Deed** or **Certificate of Incorporation** with **Memorandum & Articles of Association**
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Power of Attorney** or **Board Resolution** (for authorized signatory)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-A** (Undertaking for Acceptance of Tender Terms)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-B** (Declaration on Proceedings Under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-C** (Compliance Certificate for bidders from countries sharing land border with India)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-D** (Declarations for Non-Tampering of Tender)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-E** (Declarations for Blacklisting / Holiday Listing)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-F** (Details on Relationship With IOCL’s Directors)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-G** (Undertaking for Business Transaction Status)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-H** (Particulars of Bidder Firm)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-I** (Undertaking on No Multiple Bidding)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-J (Part I & II)** (Declaration for Purchase Preference & Local Content)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Annexure-L** (Confirmation on Applicability of MSE)
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **TReDS Registration** (Mandatory for MSME bidders)

### 3. Exemption Documents Required
* **Proof for Exemption (MSEs)**: **MSE Udyam Registration Certificate** (Explicit)
* **Proof for Exemption (Start-ups)**: **DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate** (Explicit)

### 4. Physical Submissions (Offline)
* **Bid Security Declaration / EMD Instrument**: (Only if applicable as per tender, though EMD is NIL, original instruments like Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond for SD/PBG must be submitted if opted)
  * Deadline: Within 7 working days from technical bid opening (for BG/ISB)
  * In Favor Of: **Indian Oil Corporation Limited**
  * Payable At: **New Delhi**
  * Delivery Address: **Materials & Contracts, Northern Region, Indian Oil Bhavan, Yusuf Sarai, New Delhi 110016**

### 5. Key Commercial Terms & Conditions to Follow
* **Option Clause**: Purchaser reserves the right to increase/decrease quantity by 25% at contracted rates.
* **Security Deposit (SD) / Performance Guarantee**: 5% of order value, valid till delivery/completion period + warranty period + 6 months.
* **Defect Liability Period**: 12 months from the date of completion of work.
* **Reverse Auction**: Applicable as per GeM modality.
* **Splitting of Order**: 60:40 ratio between L1 and L2 bidders.
* **Payment Terms**: 100% payment within 30 days from receipt of bills and verification/certification by IOCL.
* **Safety Penalty**: Rs. 5,000 per occasion for safety violations; 0.5% of contract value for physical injury; 1% for fatal accidents.
* **Language**: All documents must be in English; translated documents must be notarized.
* **GST Compliance**: Invoice must contain GSTIN of the specific location of supply.
